posts.author: MatidiaRM
posts.body:
SYNOPSIS
You wake up in the middle of a snowy landscape. You don't remember how you got there, but you must find a way out of this place; otherwise you will end up frozen forever.
Help Noah find it's way out of this place full of hostile creatures and solve the mystery behind the...
SCREENSHOTS
DEVELOPMENT
“36” is a short game with elements of survival and a bit of psychological horror with 3 different endings. Originally created for the horror jam about polar exploration. It is a mix between psychological horror with a touch of humor.
GAME TRAILER
DOWNLOAD AND CREDITS
Download the game from its page at itch.io:
"36"
Game made in RPG MAKER 2003.
Graphics, music and development made by Matidia.

posts.author: Himex998
posts.body:
Hello!
I have played the game for around 40 minutes and it deserves more fame! Really really love how you used only black & white colours, it reminds me of old gen 1 pokemon games, graphics are very nice in general and I think the general game idea is original, which is the best <3. I also would like to report a bug I've found - if you complete math minigame but will leave the classroom without picking the key, you will be softlocked (since you won't be able to come back or come to another class). I think it's all I have to say, I've uploaded part 1 playthrought of your game on my Youtube channel but please tell me ASAP if you want me to delete it. So far my rating is 9/10 (Even though I suck at logical minigames... XD).
Also, if there's any chance you may explain the computer science minigame? I was trying to get it right however nothing I tried really worked, so yep. That's all, thank you very much for reading, good luck with game developement!
